description: A dramatic contemporary Chinese-influenced foyer and staircase landing with Zen garden elements. The right half of the frame is dominated by a broad staircase rising steeply in honed travertine or limestone tiles — the treads and risers both in the same warm cream-beige stone — with a slim glass panel railing held by a minimal dark-bronze metal post. Small brass step-light inserts glow softly along the right riser wall. The left half reveals a contemplative alcove set into the wall: a large circular moon-gate opening frames a shallow built-in display shelf in warm walnut with ceramic vessels in celadon and white — cups, bowls, a vase — arranged in orderly fashion. A large, magnificently shaped bonsai pine in a deep oxblood rectangular pot sits on a floating walnut ledge below the moon-gate circle. At floor level in the alcove, raked fine gravel and a dramatic arrangement of dark textured rocks create a dry Zen garden tableau. The walls are smooth plaster in warm cream. A cascade of alabaster or frosted-stone cylinders in brass fittings hangs through the double-height void beside the staircase, each glowing warmly from within and pooling amber light down onto the gravel below. Camera at standing eye-level, one-point perspective slightly angled, showing both the staircase and the Zen alcove in one frame, normal lens, level pitch. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
